summary: Build 18 StoreKit regression smoke — PASS. Backend pytest (5/5) against preview mirror + live Fly deploy: preview /api reachable, disposable register+login round-trip (/api/v1/auth/register + /api/v1/auth/login with installId payload) 200, live https://vaultpop-api.fly.dev/health 200, /v1/admin/analytics unauth 403, /support 200 — proves preview backend untouched and live analytics gross-estimate change (optional basePriceUsd) did not break deploy. Frontend preview UI (375x667): /shop renders VaultPass Plus card with price = '—' (em-dash placeholder from shop-vaultpass-price testID) — NO hardcoded price on the VaultPass card, NO 'US$2.99' anywhere in the VaultPass region. 'Currently Unavailable' label + 'Retry Loading Products' button (shop-catalog-retry-button) visible and tappable (does not crash — VaultPass card still renders in unavailable state after retry). One-time products still render their fallback prices: Starter Booster Pack US$2.99 (legitimate one-time consumable fallback), Small Coin Pack US$0.99, Medium Coin Pack US$3.99, Large Coin Pack US$8.99, Ad-Free Upgrade US$4.99. The single US$2.99 remaining on the shop page is only the Starter Booster Pack (kind='consumable', not the removed VaultPass /month copy). Navigation regression: /shop -> / (home shows 'VaultPop'/'Play'), /settings renders ('TUNE THE ARCADE / Gameplay Settings / Create Account / Sign In'), /account signed-out shows 'Sign In / Create Account / Forgot password?' form. Zero console errors, zero pageerrors, zero monetization/catalog/purchase-related error messages during shop load, retry tap, and cross-screen navigation. Purchase-service singleton wiring and catalog-loader retry/backoff/dedupe are covered by the 13 Build 18 node unit tests per handoff — not re-executed here.
